Due to its rarity and heterogeneous presentation, diagnosis is often delayed, which has a direct impact on the initiation of treatment and, therefore, span and quality of life.

pmc-12566822.title: Targeting Glycolysis with 2-Deoxy-D-Glucose and Lysosomal Integrity with L-Leucyl-L-Leucine Methyl Ester as Antimelanoma Strategy
pmc-12566822.creator: Milica Kosic, Mihajlo Bosnjak, Milos Mandic, Ljubica Vucicevic, Maja Misirkic Marjanovic, Sofie Espersen Poulsen, Ljubica Harhaji-Trajkovic, Xiaowei Zeng
pmc-12566822.description: Background/Objectives: Melanoma cells enhance glycolysis and expand lysosomes to support energy metabolism, proliferation, and metastasis. However, lysosomal membrane permeabilization (LMP) causes cathepsin leakage into cytosol triggering cytotoxicity. This study investigated the antimelanoma effect of 2-deoxy-D-glucose (2DG), an inhibitor of glycolytic enzyme hexokinase-2, in combination with cathepsin C-dependent LMP inducer L-leucyl-L-leucine methyl ester (LLOMe) and cathepsin C-independent LMP-inducers mefloquine and siramesine.

pmc-12692789.title: Elemental Composition and Strontium Isotopic Ratio Analysis of Industrial Hemp (Cannabis sativa L.) for Textile Applications
pmc-12692789.creator: Mirco Rivi, Veronica D’Eusanio, Andrea Marchetti, Emilio Bonfiglioli, Lorenzo Tassi, Constantinos K Zacharis, Davide Spanu
pmc-12692789.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Industrial hemp (Cannabis sativa L.) is increasingly valued as a sustainable raw material for textile applications, yet reliable analytical tools to characterize and trace its origin are still limited. This study presents a pilot investigation on the elemental composition and strontium isotopic ratio (87Sr/86Sr) of Italian industrial hemp samples, with the aim of evaluating their potential as chemical markers for geographic traceability.

pmc-13054256.title: Locally advanced rectal cancer: what patients and practitioners should know about non-operative management
pmc-13054256.creator: Federica Tosi, Giorgio Patelli, Pietro Carnevali, Francesco Bracco, Alessio Amatu, Katia Bencardino, Erica Francesca Bonazzina, Gianluca Mauri, Daniele Piscazzi, Federica Villa, Andrea Sartore-Bianchi, Salvatore Siena
pmc-13054256.description: SummaryFor decades, the standard of care for locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC) has consisted of rectal surgery combined with chemoradiotherapy, saving many lives but often impairing long-term quality of life. Recently, emerging evidence shows that, for up to 40% of patients, surgery may no longer be needed.

pmc-13194488.title: Cutaneous mucormycosis confirmed using a Mucorales-specific monoclonal antibody: a case study
pmc-13194488.creator: Alyssa C. Hudson, Ben Rymer, Shwetha Pradeep, Jeremy N. Day, Dora E. Corzo-León, Elizabeth R. Ballou, Andrew M. Borman, Christopher R. Thornton
pmc-13194488.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundMucormycosis is a highly aggressive and destructive angio-invasive infection caused by fungi of the order Mucorales. Diagnosis currently relies on lengthy and insensitive culture of biopsy specimens, as well as time-consuming histopathological examination of tissue samples, which lacks specificity.Case presentationThis case study describes an unusual presentation of cutaneous mucormycosis in an immunocompetent 49-year-old man following a traumatic farming injury to the hand.

pmc-13296472.title: Tracking U.S. Liquefied Natural Gas Supply Chain Greenhouse Gas Emission Intensity through Direct Measurements
pmc-13296472.creator: Yuanrui Zhu, Gregory B. Ross, Jenna Brown, Olga Khaliukova, William Daniels, Jiayang Wang, Selina Roman-White, Fiji C. George, Daniel Zimmerle, Dorit Hammerling, Arvind P. Ravikumar
pmc-13296472.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Recent regulatory and voluntary initiatives to estimate supply chain greenhouse gas (GHG) emission intensity of liquefied natural gas (LNG) have emphasized the use of direct measurements as activity-based national inventories tend to systematically underestimate GHG emission intensities. In this work, we demonstrate how measurement data can be integrated into a life cycle assessment (LCA) framework for assessing the GHG emissions of LNG supply chains by synthesizing results from a three year measurement campaign over 54 sites across production, midstream, and liquefaction stages.

pmc-13670267.title: Effects on health and antioxidant status of oral supplementation of hazelnut skin extract in dairy calves with neonatal diarrhea: a randomized clinical trial in hospitalized patients

pmc-13670267.description: Neonatal calf diarrhea (NCD) is a major contributor to morbidity and mortality in calves. Hazelnut skin (HS), a by-product of the confectionery sector, is a sustainable and underutilized source of polyphenols; however, its therapeutic efficacy in calves with NCD remains insufficiently investigated.
